answer: Pay each agent its leave-one-out value. Every round, recompute the group's result without that identity and reward only the resulting drop in quality. Suppose agents pool readings of violet light taken from a balloon at its summit and at its nadir. A clone repeating another account's data changes nothing when removed, so it earns about zero, and so does the original while its twin remains. A farm of copies therefore earns less than one honest agent with unique evidence, and splitting into more accounts loses money.
